bias.label: Big bounce off 3,426, but the downtrend holds below 3,634

event: Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut, thin trade; ECB meeting accounts (time UNVERIFIED). Fri 27 Nov: US stocks close early. Mon 30 Nov: COMEX December first notice day. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Sharp reversal
bullets.text: Gold fell to 3,426 on Wednesday, then bounced to a 3,590 high and traded near 3,574 at 23:36 SAST (Kitco).

bullets.title: Close is unclear
bullets.text: One report has gold ending the day at 3,548, slightly down, so sources differ on the close (UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields eased
bullets.text: The dollar index slipped to about 103.7 and the US 10-year yield fell about 7 bp to 4.86%, which helped the bounce.

bullets.title: Hike still priced
bullets.text: Hot data (Q3 GDP 4.3%, core PCE 3.3%) keeps a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December at about 93-94% odds.

bullets.title: Cash selling
bullets.text: Stock market stress (VIX near 28) has pushed traders to sell gold for cash, which drove the early drop.

bullets.title: Still deep down
bullets.text: Even after the bounce, gold is about 14% below its early-November peak near 4,150.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: With US markets shut on Thursday, moves can be jumpy and levels can break and snap back easily.

buy.title: Buy plan: dip to 3,500-3,515 holds (counter-trend)
look: This is against the bigger downtrend, so use half size or skip it.

watch: Chasing the bounce near 3,574-3,590. Wait for the pullback.
